description: Set up or change the B2B store (see get_b2b_store_settings): its address slug, name, logo, colors, whether it is open, whether browsing needs a sign-in, whether prices are shown and the minimum order. Only the fields you pass change; name storeName, logoUrl, primaryColor, secondaryColor or minimumOrderAmount in clear to empty them. Setting the store up for the first time needs a slug. The same rules as the B2B Store page apply. The preview shows each setting before→after and warns when the address moves (old links and unaccepted invitations stop working) or the store opens or closes. A slug another store already uses is refused on commit. Requires an operator (unpinned) credential with Write + storefront.execute and the Admin role.

clear.description: Optional fields to empty: storeName, logoUrl, primaryColor, secondaryColor, minimumOrderAmount.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

input.description: The settings to change; omitted fields keep their current value.

isEnabled.description: Open (true) or close (false) the store to customers.

logoUrl.description: An http(s) address of the logo image.

minimumOrderAmount.description: Smallest order total the store accepts, >= 0.

requireLoginToBrowse.description: Only signed-in customers can browse the catalog.

showPrices.description: Show signed-in customers their prices in the catalog.

slug.description: The store address segment customers open (/store/<slug>): lowercase letters and numbers separated by single hyphens, e.g. "acme-wholesale". Required when the store is first set up.

storeName.description: The store name shown to customers and in invitation emails.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

name: save_b2b_store_settings
title: Save B2B Store Settings
